name: Baltic Methodist Theological Seminary
summary: Methodist seminary in Tallinn; a 3-year Theology and Mission bachelor's with an English stream, taught in monthly four-day study sessions.

ib.text: No IB points or subjects are asked: send your secondary certificate, a motivation letter and a pastor's recommendation, then pass a Bible quiz and a face-to-face interview.

programmes.name: Theology and Mission
programmes.credential: Bachelor's degree in Theology and Mission
programmes.about: Bible, theology, church history and practical ministry, with a chosen direction in congregational leadership, evangelism and apologetics, or biblical studies; offered in parallel Estonian, English and Russian curricula.
programmes.ib: You need a pastor's recommendation after at least 12 months in a congregation, plus a Bible quiz and an interview.
programmes.selectionNote: Motivation letter, pastor's recommendation, an online Bible knowledge quiz and a face-to-face interview; no grade cut-off is published. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: Teaching runs in 11 study sessions a year, Wednesday to Saturday, with some weekly online evenings, so it is not a full-time campus programme.
Students living in Estonia get a 15% tuition discount in 2026/27; the fee for everyone else is €2,600 a year, or the same total spread over four years.
The seminary offers no long-term accommodation, so you need somewhere to stay in Estonia before applying.
